title: A tour of the mallworld I've dreamt of since the early 2000s (+ some of the apocalypses it has endured)
content: (Had to do it [via imgur here](https://imgur.com/a/tour-of-mallworld-its-apocalypses-M7AdGCV) because of Reddit's upload limits. It's a photo album tour ♡) Not perfect and it's just one route, so it's missing areas in the other directions (the convenience store is like the heart of the world / near the main crossroads), but that's the idea. Things can vary too, like often the mall is underneath a larger city, where the subway and such would be, so I included the steps for entering that one. The railroad under the pier is my favorite area and where I've had the most meaningful dreams with a recurring character. Unfortunately, I couldn't find any photos that quite fit the bill (probably because it would be a dumb spot for a train in real life lol). I don't have mallworld dreams as often as I used to, so I'm not sure where my old map is. But I'll share it here if/when it shows up. Also, I knew what was meant the moment I heard the term "mallworld" yesterday haha it woke me up like a sleeper agent. It's so cool that other people have dreams in a similar recurring world! I wonder what causes it. I almost never have fantasy dreams in my mallworld, only sci-fi or realistic ones, and it's usually an apocalyptic event / natural disaster / otherwise spooky. The mall is the safe place where people end up sheltering.
